nodes.label: build()
nodes.desc: Public build entry: resolves config, discovers routes via createRoutesList, then drives AstroBuilder through setup and bundling.

nodes.label: dev()
nodes.desc: Starts the no-bundle dev server inside a container with automatic restart, wires the content data store and returns a DevServer handle.

nodes.label: createVite()
nodes.desc: Assembles the full Vite config: ~40 Astro plugins, vitefu framework-package crawl with an in-process cache, env loading and module aliases.

nodes.label: vitePluginApp()
nodes.desc: Serves the virtual:astro:app module whose body re-exports createApp from the dev or prod entrypoint depending on Vite's command.

nodes.label: astro:server plugin
nodes.desc: Dev-only plugin that wires SSR and prerender environment middleware, builds the request handler through module runners and the serialized manifest.

nodes.label: renderComponent()
nodes.desc: Renders one component to an HTML string, extracts client:* directives and hashes island identity (componentExport, componentUrl, props) to dedupe.

nodes.label: generateHydrateScript()
nodes.desc: Serializes hydration metadata into astro-island attributes: component-url, component-export, renderer-url and the revived props blob.

nodes.label: getPrescripts()
nodes.desc: Emits island styles plus hydration directive scripts; deliberately classic (non-module) scripts so callbacks fire the moment the island element is parsed.

nodes.label: AstroIsland element
nodes.desc: Source of the prebuilt <astro-island> custom element: props revival across 12 type codes, prototype-pollution guards and streaming-aware children waiting.

nodes.label: client:visible
nodes.desc: Watches the island's children with IntersectionObserver because the island host uses display: contents; disconnects after the first intersection.

nodes.label: NodeApp
nodes.desc: Production SSR app built over BaseApp: consumes the SSR manifest, matches routes, renders pages and streams responses on Node.

nodes.label: Server Island endpoint
nodes.desc: Serves /_server-islands/[name]: decrypts the s/e/p query payload, rejects plaintext slots and caps request bodies at 1MB.
